thread:
rachel (prod): small UX review: the network step's primary CTA currently says 'Run'. customers think that's vague. suggestions?
oscar (design): +1 rename to 'Run connectivity checks' — explicit and matches other buttons. also add a tooltip that explains it may fetch docs if enabled.
mina (eng): implementation note: we only fetch docs when docs_fetch_enabled. for private installs default false. we'll persist lastResult so the step doesn't say 'Untested' after a refresh.
eli (a11y): accessibility bits: make the button text explicit for SRs and add aria-describedby linking to the tooltip when visible. announce 'Running connectivity checks' (aria-live polite) once per run.
rachel (prod): copy tweak: prefer 'Connectivity check' singular in the pill and 'Run connectivity checks' for the button. also replace 'failed' with 'issue detected'.
oscar (design): I'll update Figma: button label, tooltip copy (<120 chars), and a 'stale' badge if last check >5m. keep spinner only inside the button.
mina (eng): we'll implement caching (localStorage) and add a 'Run checks' debounce so users can't spam runs. also add a small 'Offline docs' non-blocking note if KB fetch fails.
ops-bot: fetch attempt to docs.redwood.ai failed: timeout
eli (a11y): one more: allow prefers-reduced-motion to disable spinner animation and ensure focus returns to the button after results load.
rachel (prod): owners: oscar (design), eli (a11y), mina (eng). target: include in next sprint. thanks! :heart:
